rootCauses: PDF substring search treated title/data bytes as a PDF file and rejected late prose during vector extraction.
Preview/BoundingBox searches ignored DSC document and data scope, showing imported preview or cropping parent artwork to child bounds.
fix: Shared byte-preserving DSC scope scan for parent preview/BoundingBox and vector input.
Imported vector code retained; opaque data and preview bytes isolated, top-level EOF respected.
Bounded exact data counters, 64 document levels and 10000 opaque blocks; malformed input explicit.
Versioned PDF signature with preceding PostScript-header ownership; native-tolerated prefixes preserved.

references.scope: pp28/33-34/45-46/68: nested documents, (atend), physical byte/line counts and procedure invocation inside data sections.
EPS handling requires header BoundingBox; NOEPS disables special DSC processing. Four (atend) artwork checks use an explicit canvas, not independent automatic bounds.

nativeInterpreter.scope: Original EPS byte streams executed in a separate process/virtual filesystem; -c showpage asks the interpreter to display EPS artwork without rewriting input. Does not compare EPSI preview comments to painted artwork. Pixel comparisons performed separately in verify-ai-dsc.js.
